messages.subject: Project Kestrel - mutual NDA for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Victor,

Further to your call with Sarah, please find attached the mutual non-disclosure agreement for the proposed Series B investment in Caspian Technologies (Project Kestrel). The terms are standard and mutual, with a two-year confidentiality period.

If acceptable, please arrange signature and we will countersign for the Company. Once in place we can open the data room and share the information memorandum.

Kind regards,
Elena
Elena Marchetti  |  Associate

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
